title: tap observes only the success variant, tapError only the error variant, and neither replaces the Result
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Matching and Transformation', requires tap and tapError among the compiler-aware Result operations. The order of the first two lines is the point: the observation on the success path fires and the one on the error path does not, and vice versa; the last two lines prove the observed Result was passed through unchanged.
